title: COWL & DASH PANEL HOLE PIERCING
summary: Holes to drill or pierce in the cowl and dash panel (firewall, seen from the engine side) before installing other parts: two .37 holes and an 11/16 hole for all cars (UPC 1), extra holes at existing dimples for RPO C60 air conditioning, and a 1.00 and 7/32 hole for RPO M20 4-speed. Locations are dimensioned from the circled body grid lines. No parts installed on this sheet.
notes: A UPC 1: 1. .37 ± .01 Dia. (2) holes using cover dash as a template. 2. 11/16 ± .02 Dia. hole at existing dimple.
B RPO C60: 1. 11/16 ± .02 Dia. hole at existing dimple. 2. 1.62 ± .02 Dia. hole at existing dimple. 3. 7/32 + 0 - 1/64 Dia. (4) holes at location shown.
C RPO M20: 1. 1.00 Dia. hole. 2. 7/32 Dia. hole.
notes_internal: Hole-location sheet: boxed codes (A1, A2, B2, B3, C1, C2) mark holes in the drawing; no part numbers, so no parts/fastening.
Large circled numbers 0, 5, 15, 20, 25, 30 on lines through the panel are body grid/reference lines, not callouts or revision symbols. Small circled 1-5 next to codes are revision symbols.
B1 (11/16 hole for C60) is not flagged in the drawing that I could find; locations of A1, A2, B2, B3, C1, C2 are flagged.
'±' read from a '+' with underline in the notes and rev 1.

Title block drawing number 3965172; DR DP/C1, CK 4-18-69 C1, PREL 3-24-69, C/O A10, ECR blank; L-89744; model 19000. Rev 1 AUTH 25987 DR RS; rev 2 25987 JD; rev 4 28321; rev 5 CK C1. Only rev 1 dated.
